full_judgment: 9. It appears that the suit was filed by the plaintiff-petitioner for declaration of title and for recovery of khas possession of a portion of the suit land shown in a separate schedule. Only defendant Nos.1 and 2 contested the suit by filing written statement. The trial Court dismissed the suit. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the decree of the trial Court, the plaintiff petitioner filed Title Appeal No. 56 of 1990 before the District Judge, Sylhet, Defendant Nos.1 and 2 since deceased also filed Cross-Objection No.6 of 1990 against some of the findings of the trial Court.
